description: Assumed-breach exercise scenarios for cyber recovery validation

scenarios.trigger: EDR alert: encryption activity on app node
scenarios.response: Isolate segment; declare assumed-breach; clean-room rebuild

scenarios.trigger: Registry scan: unsigned or digest mismatch vs SBOM
scenarios.response: Admission rejects deploy; rebuild from signed digest only

scenarios.trigger: SOC: exfiltration of service account token
Backup checksum mismatch vs WORM catalog
scenarios.response: Reject restore; use alternate backup generation
Fail closed; use offline digest manifest + manual key ceremony

scenarios.trigger: Unauthorized workflow run or secret exfil from GitHub Actions
scenarios.response: Revoke CI tokens; rebuild from last verified signed tag
